A separate restored branch attacks Hero, ends, then Hero retreats to (1,0), opponent declines OA and obtains real Press. Historical saved boundaries exist for OA, KO and Press.

Independently restore that genuine predecessor and submit each exact CombatStance value under the current FirstOpponent turn. Three values are eligible; Mobile and Carrying retain their exact native denials. No snapshot edits or seeded rerolls.

FERRY.steps: Reuse the accepted fresh-campaign prefix, actual paid Ferry admission and first-fire save. Route uses real Player and FerryOpponent submissions plus authorized automatic source actions. Existing branches retain ordinary Claw, real Press follow, AskIfEligible source KO and both response choices. These are retained TAC-10 inputs, not rerun qualification.

FERRY_KO.steps: Restore the accepted replay boundary and replay exact retained authoritative commands to genuine pre-KO combat. Hero submits owned Club attack with KnockOutIfEligible and KeepExisting against the living source creature; source becomes Stable rather than Dead. FERRY_SANCTUARY.steps: From accepted first fire, companion casts owned Sanctuary on Hero, source makes genuine failed Claw admission with AskIfEligible/ArmOrReplace. Strict-restore the pending admission for Forgo and Retarget-to-Companion branches. A later Hero departure while the failed-save cache is active yields an actually prohibited source OA that is declined without spending Reaction; next owner Start refreshes admission.

FERRY_SEAL.steps: Reuse accepted tactical first-fire to paid seal tear, and accepted pre-contact world save for own-slot/other-slot ordinary Hero seal tears. CASTING.steps: CastingFirstOwnTurn begins through StartVialScenario, actual walk/contact/reinforcement and original turn sequence. Hero moves to (1,1) then (2,0) under real response handling, and takes Hide. Companion later searches (2,0). Existing query calls sometimes access the owned Simulation directly, so they do not prove new public V1 reads.

CASTING_SANCTUARY.steps: Pay Sanctuary on Hero, allow actual LaterDefender actions until failed admission. Future V1 witness must use the existing SubmitDefenderSanctuary host route, preserving that original command and exact trusted grant. Automatic opportunity-forgo continuation is separately genuine.

One-target Presence on Hero, declined OA, actual Frightened movement denial and later paid attack are retained. Actual initial carried Reaction route supplies a genuine owned-Club OA before the source next Start.

Campaign route retains weighted actual partial movement interruptions. Strain lock test supplies actual next-Start Dash revalidation; distinguish any detached setup in other geometry cases.

Confirm actual stage. At the authored predecessor, move Companion west then north to (3,2), Hero three north to (1,0), paying/completing each edge as in the model window helper. This composes demonstrated public prefix and native movement/start conditions; no complete paid host observation trace has yet been executed.
